name: legacy_supply_request_v1
description: Single-page legacy Accredo 'Prescription and Supply Request Form' (RA variant), photographed off a screen with perspective skew. Boxes derived from an ink-profile pass (flat-field corrected, ruling lines removed), then widened to absorb skew. Fractions of the page, so resolution-independent.
method: profile.py -> text bands; boxes padded +/-1.5% to tolerate perspective skew

regions.contains: patient name, date of birth, phone, active address

deliberately_visible: diagnosis code and allergy entry (clinical, non-identifying)
known_tradeoffs: the substitution election row is masked along with the prescriber identifiers, so that section cannot be assessed on the redacted copy
the form title is deliberately left visible
